Liquid glass visual reference
============================

The reading room's standalone CSS/SVG glass layer is inspired by the backdrop
refraction, separate content layer, RGB dispersion and specular rim techniques in:
https://github.com/rdev/liquid-glass-react
Reference revision: ac48eab18d1f7f444ae30002d240cae29c863a21 (v1.1.1).

The runtime uses its own rounded-rectangle displacement map and DOM lifecycle;
React, the upstream package and upstream image assets are not runtime dependencies.
The reference project's MIT license is retained below.

Additional visual and technical references for the complete manager material:
https://kube.io/blog/liquid-glass-css-svg/
https://aave.com/design/building-glass-for-the-web
https://codepen.io/mr-tipton/pen/YPqGgxa
https://github.com/VII-Cae/hyalite--liquid-glass
https://glass.outpacestudios.com/
https://liquid-glass.maxrovensky.com/
https://github.com/Kyant0/AndroidLiquidGlass

The manager's local CSS, SVG backdrop and optical runtime are original assets.
Its convex-rim sampling, subtle RGB dispersion and pointer-driven highlights
apply to backdrop layers only; text and artwork remain separate. None of the
additional reference projects is bundled or required at runtime.
